proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  refine ⟨t.orthocenter_mem_altitude, ?_⟩
  have hsum : ∀ f : Fin 3 → V, ∑ l, f l = f i + f j + f k := by
    intro f
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;> simp_all <;> abel
  have h := t.orthocenter_vsub_circumcenter_eq_sum_vsub
  rw [hsum] at h
  have hj := t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius j
  have hk := t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius k
  rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V] at hj hk
  have e1 : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points i = (t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right t.orthocenter (t.points i) t.circumcenter, h]; abel
  have e2 : t.points j -ᵥ t.points k = (t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter) - (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) :=
    (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
  rw [e1, e2, inner_add_left, inner_sub_right, inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_comm, hj, hk]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → t.orthocenter ∈ t.altitude i ∧ inner ℝ (t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points i) (t.points j -ᵥ t.points k) = 0
